overloads.semanticRole: PUSH RECORD pushes the current record of aTable (and its subrecords, if any) onto the table’s record stack.may be executed before a record is saved.

constraints: A record pushed while unlocked stays locked for all other processes/users until it is popped (POP RECORD) and unloaded.
Compatibility note: since 4D v11, this command no longer supports subtables.
